title: Rav Reuven Chinn Passes
body: Rav Reuven Chinn zt”l, a renowned talmid chacham and mechanech, passed away at 73 after suffering cardiac arrest. He was a pillar at Yeshiva Gedolah of Toronto for nearly four decades.

title: Police Rebuke Chareidi WhatsApp
body: Israeli police scolded chareidi community WhatsApp groups for spreading false claims the search for missing 19-year-old Eliyahu Aba Shaul had been halted, prompting an immediate police response.

title: Young Lakewood Girl Passes Away
body: Lakewood, NJ resident Batsheva Lieberman, 10, daughter of R' Elimelech Shmuel and Devorah Leeba Lieberman, has passed away. Levayah tonight at 9 PM at Congregation Sons of Israel Holocaust Memorial Chapel.
